name: Yaezakura Miru
source:
Likes: Alcohol, [url=/c87752]Hibari's[/url] cooking, drinking
Dislikes: Milk, alcohol prohibition

Despite some changes, Miru still remains mostly the same - she hates talking about marriage and her age, is a heavy drinker and is very easy to talk to. She now works at a different school from the first game's due to a transfer, and she's also the adviser for the student council. She changed her mind about smoking and as such dropped the habit, but has no intention to quit drinking. Despite having no personal romantic experience, she is quite good at giving it thanks to her students at her former school. As of late Miru dropped convenience store lunches in favor of cooking her own food (for the sake of her "bride training"), but she also depends on Hibari and her cooking.
